_note: ALGO SAYS cards. A lesson fires the first time its conditions hold at the moment named by when (analysis = first results, done = the post ended, return = a return came in, update = after a platform update). if = all conditions [fact, op, value]. any = a list of condition lists, one must hold. Facts are built in js/sim/lessons.js.

lessons.text: Posting is not enough. Timing and fit decide reach.
